qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for S14 connecting rod bolts?
What is the main torque value for S38 connecting rod bolts?
What is the main torque specification for S50 connecting rod bolts?
Which engine has the highest connecting rod bolt torque specification?
Do S38 and S50 engines use the same application torque for connecting rod bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both use 5 Nm application torque

qa_pairs.question: What procedure should be followed when installing connecting rod bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace, wash and oil connecting rod bolts before installation
